title: Mollugin Derivatives as Anti-Inflammatory Agents: Design, Synthesis, and NF-kappaB Inhibition.
authors: Gao, Yuan-Liang; Li, Ming-Yue; Wang, Da-Yuan; Jin, Shi-Ang; Ma, Xin-Yu; Jin, Xue-Jun; Piao, Hu-Ri
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成莫林衍生物并评估其抗炎活性，仅以NF-kappaB转录抑制为表型终点，分子对接用于小分子-蛋白结合而非蛋白-DNA互作建模，与本课题TF-DNA互作研究无关。
abstract: Nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) is a key inducible transcription factor that controls a large number of genes involved in inflammatory and immune processes. The entire inflammation-mediated process uses NF-kappaB as a hub, and inflammatory gene transcription and expression can be decreased by blocking the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, thereby reducing inflammatory damage. Therefore, the inhibition of this pathway is an important therapeutic target for the treatment of various types of inflammation. Here, we designed and synthesized 27 mollugin derivatives and evaluated the anti-inflammatory activity against NF-kappaB transcription. Most of the compounds exhibited potent anti-inflammatory activity, and compound 5k was the most potent with 81.77% inhibition after intraperitoneal administration, which was significantly more potent than mollugin (49.72%), ibuprofen (47.51%), and mesalazine (47.24%). Investigation of the mechanism of action indicated that 5k down-regulated NF-kappaB expression, possibly by suppressing LPS-induced expression of the p65 protein. ADMET prediction analysis indicated that compounds 5h and 5k showed good pharmacokinetic properties. The relationship between the structures of the synthesized compounds and the NF-kappaB inhibitory activity was rationalized using molecular docking simulation experiments. Overall, these results provide an initial basis for the development of 5h and 5k as potential anti-inflammatory agents.
abstract_zh: 核因子kappaB（NF-kappaB）是一种关键的诱导型转录因子，调控着大量参与炎症和免疫过程的基因。整个炎症介导过程以NF-kappaB为中心，通过阻断NF-kappaB信号通路可降低炎症基因的转录和表达，从而减轻炎症损伤。因此，抑制该通路是治疗各类炎症的重要治疗靶点。在此，我们设计并合成了27种莫芦丁衍生物，并评估了其对NF-kappaB转录的抗炎活性。大多数化合物表现出强效的抗炎活性，其中化合物5k在腹腔给药后抑制率最高，达81.77%，显著强于莫芦丁（49.72%）、布洛芬（47.51%）和美沙拉嗪（47.24%）。作用机制研究表明，5k可能通过抑制脂多糖诱导的p65蛋白表达来下调NF-kappaB表达。ADMET预测分析显示，化合物5h和5k具有良好的药代动力学特性。通过分子对接模拟实验，对合成化合物的结构与NF-kappaB抑制活性之间的关系进行了合理化解释。总体而言，这些结果为开发5h和5k作为潜在抗炎药物提供了初步基础。
